column3: Manami Route ・ An Interlude in the Closing Ceremony
I have to tell Manami how I feel...
But what should I say... I'm not good with words.
At times like this, what am I supposed to do...?
Manami, I...
At the very least, I don't hate you, nor dislike you even at all... not one bit.
O-Okay... Thanks...
But, Kyou-chan, you're hesitating now... right? If that wasn't the case, we wouldn't be having this conversation...
That's because Kyou-chan is such a kind person...
Manami...
Talking as we walk won't work. I just have to tell her properly!
Why don't we sit in the park and talk? I can't focus on the conversation while I'm walking.
O-Okay...
Manami... She's following, right..?
Manami was tottering a few steps just behind me. She's steadily following me, but she seemed depressed.
Good, there's no one around.
I see... Yes, this way, you can take your time.
Shall we sit here?
...Sure.
She smiled and laughed. But something's definitely wrong.
Am I the one to blame for that face?
There's no way this relationship will ever change... is false. This I understand.
Can I ask you one thing?
Yes... What is it?
The day after the school trip, you told me, "Be my boyfriend".
Why did you bring that up so suddenly?
Why, you say...
That's a weird, indirect way to put it, but it can't be helped. Now that I think about it, it's around that time that I started to think "she's strange".
The Manami I know isn't the kind who's bold enough to say such things like that.
What changed you?
Recently, I've been exchanging emails and phone calls with someone.
I told her that recently, my childhood friend seemed troubled for various reasons, and asked for advice.
And she told me "You have to support him by becoming his girlfriend".
Then, I said "Well then! I'll do my best."
Yeah, I understand...
In short, this means Manami took advice from some friend I know nothing about.
Troubled for various reasons she says. She must be referring to the recent uproars with Kuroneko, Kirino and all them.
There's a high possibility that the so-called adviser misinterpreted "childhood friend" as "love interest".
Falling in love with your childhood friend is a recurring theme in Galge too.
Say, Manami. You know me really well, don't you?
Hm? Ah, yes... For example, during the 2nd year of elementary school, you came over to my house, wet your bed and blamed it on Rock.
While that's true, I'm pretty sure it has nothing to do with this!
Ahah! S-Sorry...
Err, you also know how I can only throw balls straight like an idiot, right?
Kyou-chan's not an idiot～
No, I am an idiot. Because right now, I don't even know what I'm trying to say to you.
Okay! I'll say it! The things I feel, I'll tell them all to Manami!
Manami, I like it when we are together.
Yes... Thanks...
But there's one more thing I must say.
One more thing?
I like the old Manami more than the current Manami.
Ah...
The old... Me?
Though the word "old" may not be completely accurate.
Am I... weird now?
I just... ugh, I can't say it right. I still don't understand it myself.
But, will you listen to me?
Yes...
Always going home together, the carefree chats.
Occasionally going to your house, eating Japanese sweets, and so on.
Yes.
Those things were really nice.
Oh. I'm glad...
I think I don't really need anything special. That is, when I'm with you.
I mean... you simply being here with me is enough...
Kyou-chan...
When I'm with you... is when I'm the most at ease.
The most...
That's right. Even if we don't do anything special, it's no big deal.
Like, how should I say this... Warmth?
Warmth...?
Yeah. I like the warmth we share.
I see... Then, I really have to turn back to my old se--
No. Wait.
Oh?
You don't have to turn back to anything. Because I also "like" the "current" Manami.
Kyou-chan...?
See, I wasn't joking when I said "New Manami". Surpass both "past" and "present" to become a new Manami in the future. How does that sound?
The future... me?
In front of me, Manami, with sparkling eyes, totally looked like the stereotypical "childhood friend" from a Galge.
Yes. Like... after you have chosen the correct choice in a very important scene and are confident in your ability to see the one true end.
Manami and I are "childhood friends" and "lovers". Rather than choose one over the other, we should aim for something more later on.
Yes, okay～
Are you really okay with this?
Yes.
I... didn't I say something really awful?
No～, It's not awful at all. I understand, too.
The old me is more like me... Surely, this is the true me. But the current me is also undeniably me, so I have to cherish them both!
Also, Kyou-chan was uneasy, so I understood, "As we are now, it just won't work".
S-so, so you understand?!
That's because Kyou-chan is so easy to understand!
Am I?
Yes!
With this... It's seems,for now, things worked out?
Uff, But I have to apologize to Ayase-chan...
......Ayase?
Ah? Just forget it, okay? Hehe.
...So that's how it is, huh...
I guessed the ringleader.
There was a VERY good reason for Manami's sudden obsession with a romantic relationship.
Seriously... But, oh well.
Because of that, I understood what the important thing that I wanted to do was.
Kyou-chan.
Hm? What is it?
Thanks for coming out and telling me.
No problem.
I accepted those last words from Manami as they were, completely unaware of how much I would regret them.
The usual atmosphere was flowing around us.
So I pretended not to notice.
The fact that behind Manami's glasses, her eyes were slightly teary.
I... It's just a thought and I don't know if it's right or not but...
Hm?
You... Maybe you've fallen in love with the idea of love?
In love... with love?
Yeah, it seemed like that.
Am I weird somehow...
Not weird, just... different, I guess. It only seems like you were overdoing things. Honestly.
Over... doing it?
Yes, I told you; I don't know how I feel myself.
Also, it seemed like you were being really careful for my sake.
Since your attitude changed suddenly, what am I supposed to do?
Kyou-chan...
Sorry. Those are my honest feelings.
Thank you, Kyou-chan. You really know how I am...
That's because we're always together.
Yes! Always together!
Yes, Manami nodded, finally cracking a smile. I could feel the tense atmosphere loosen slightly.
This is the usual warmth between Manami and me. The feeling I could see lasting forever.
I see, that's true. Kyou-chan was having a hard time.
Yeah! It was really a pain!
Ehehe... Sorry.
Don't be. There's no rush, right?
Yes.
Because we've always been together, haven't we?
And even from now on... maybe?
Yup. I think so.
I don't like sudden changes, but we can do it gradually. Manami and I will definitely stick together.
Just like the big river.
You think so?
Yes. The flow of a river is something that never seems to change, but it still changes little by little, right?
That's true.
Perhaps that way of changing is the best.
Don't you have it all figured out already? Ahahah...
That's not true, I only just realized it! "Slow is just fine."
This is how it is between us, right?
Yes!
Kyou-chan, I don't really understand what you mean... Maybe you don't like me-
Gah!! I told you that's not it!
Take a deep breath... blow it out... okay, Ready!
Manami!
H-Hyaww!
To be unable to escape from this, I firmly gripped Manami's shoulders.
I'm not sure I can say this right. But, I definitely won't lie!
...Okay...
I think you know this, but I'm really clumsy and awkward.
So, I'm sorry if I hurt you.
Tears? Am I crying?
No, even if I cry, I have to say it.
Kyou-chan...
I'll tell you my feelings honestly, so listen until I'm done.
Y-Yes. Understood.
Manami, so... You're fine with our new relationship, right?
*nod nod*
Including... being a couple, right?
Okay. I understand your feelings, and it's not like I'm not interested in you.
Not like... You're not..?
Yeah... But... Give me time.
That may be a pitiful thing to say, but I'm not omnipotent.
So give me time in order to be able to think of you as a girlfriend.
If not... The time we spent together up until now... It seems like it'll be completely ruined.
I really don't want that. For me, the time I spent together with you... It just feels so incredible.
Kyou-chan!
I definitely don't want to just throw it all away!
Crap... that was really passionate.
Teeheehee.
Manami's face is really red and there's no question my face is the same as hers.
Yes, I understand. Thank you for opening your heart to me.
Gently, Manami's hand brushed mine. Out fingertips touched naturally without any tension.
Let's take our time... take things slow, Kyou-chan.
I was thinking about it the whole time. The distance between Manami and me, the memories we have together. No matter how you look at it, we've spent
a lot of time together.
And so, she advised Manami that she should become my girlfriend to support me. She is the real culprit behind Manami's attitude those past few
days.
